annotations.title: List data orders and download links

description: List the data orders on the account behind an Engagemii data API key: order number, records, date, status (preparing, ready or pending), and a download link for each ready file (a delivered file never changes). The same as GET https://api.engagemii.com/api/v1/data/orders. Requires an Engagemii data API key.

api_key.description: Your Engagemii data API key (edk_...). Only needed when the key is not already sent as a request header.
